name: Ethionamide

examples.title: Patients Response to Early Switch To Oral:Osteomyelitis Study
examples.why: Not enough patient enrollment and lack of staffing

examples.title: The Individualized M(X) Drug-resistant TB Treatment Strategy Study
examples.why: WHO 2022 guidelines for DR-TB treatment are set to change. These guidelines recommend the use of an all-oral short course BPAL regimen.Therefore ongoing implementation of the study is considered…

summary: Based on a small computer model rather than human testing, Ethionamide received a medium risk score of 59 for liver problems and a low risk score of 22 for heart problems [M]. There are two clinical trials listed for this drug from a search that found three [3]. One trial stopped early because of low patient sign-ups and not enough staff [4]. Another trial ended early due to upcoming changes in treatment guidelines from the World Health Organization [5].
